pageMonitor.diff.urlsRemoved: URLs no longer in the script

pageMonitor.pageDescription: The scripts and content of your web pages, and what changed on them.
pageMonitor.removeBody: Its scripts, stored snapshots and change history are deleted.

pageMonitor.suggestions.description: Home, sign-in and admin pages and scripts of your web services that nobody watches yet.
